name: Remorhaz
summary: A huge burrowing monstrosity that radiates intense heat.

traits.name: Heat Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from the remorhaz takes {dmg:3d10:fire}.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=17}), and it has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Swallow

save.targets: one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time)

bonusActions.onFailure:
The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the {ref:condition/grappled} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {ref:condition/blinded} and {ref:condition/restrained} conditions, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes {dmg:3d6:acid} plus {dmg:3d6:fire} at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a {dc=15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {ref:condition/prone}.
